project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-10. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Marshchapel qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST MARY and Cross in St Mary's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Marshchapel: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Marshchapel offers CHURCH OF ST MARY, Cross in St Mary's churchyard, CROSS IN CHURCHYARD TO CHURCH OF ST MARY within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST MARY
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST MARY and Cross in St Mary's churchyard, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: CROSS IN CHURCHYARD TO CHURCH OF ST MARY
